MonoBrowser 0.7.2

- New logo: an "M" tile with a hatched shadow (app icon, window icon and installer)
- Calmer touchpad gestures: two-finger back/forward needs a longer, deliberate swipe, and diagonal or vertical scrolling no longer navigates by accident
- Swiping over the vertical tab bar switches only one space per gesture

Downloads:
- Windows: `MonoBrowser-Setup-0.7.2.exe`
- Linux: `MonoBrowser-0.7.2-x86_64.AppImage`
